title: kimi-shokunin MANIFEST
description: Schema for a portable shokunin manifest governed by this repository's canonical protocol. `roster` is the lane registry (unique by `id`). `rounds` is an append-only closure ledger: entries are never rewritten, prepended, or deleted — a wrong row is fixed by appending a closure-correction entry that carries `supersedes` pointing at the entry it replaces. Resolution is last-wins over (lane id, round): for a given lane and round, the latest entry carrying a row for that pair is the operative one. `closed_at` is required on any entry whose `lanes` map contains a not-dispatched row. A fleet copy is a vendored artifact and records the canonical revision it copies; its local history does not override this protocol.

protocol.description: path to the protocol document, e.g. PROTOCOL.md

minting_rule.description: the rank ladder in one sentence: shonen mint on proven domain demand; shokunin promotion on demonstrated end-to-end domain work; jin'i-ryu on self-iteration capability

roster.description: lane registry; entries are unique by `id` and only integrator roles write them

rounds.description: append-only closure ledger; last-wins over (lane id, round). Pre-regime historical entries may be retained even if they do not validate against this schema; every new canonical append must validate against the current constraints.

id.description: short lane id, unique across the roster

domain.description: the lane's province in one line

rank.description: shonen = minted probationary lane; shokunin = promoted; jin'i-ryu = self-iterating

repo.description: lane repo name (sibling of the fleet repo)

round.description: the fleet round this entry closes or annotates; fractional ids (e.g. 11.5) name between-round ledger events (mint, ops)

lane.description: lane id for a future lane-specific closure entry

lane_round.description: the lane's own round number for a future lane-specific closure entry

type.description: scaffold = roster seeding; work = round record with lane statuses; ops = driver/runtime note; closure = per-lane-round closure with statuses; closure-correction = appended fix to a prior entry's rows (carries supersedes); retroactive-closure = evidence-only closure of a pre-regime round; mint = lane minted, roster row pending probation

closed_at.description: when the closure was recorded, ISO 8601 with numeric offset; REQUIRED whenever any lanes row is not-dispatched

lanes.description: closure status per lane id present this round; in-flight is debt resolved by an appended closure-correction

additionalProperties.description: ok = verified report landed; failed = dispatched but no conformant report; not-dispatched = no dispatch evidence exists; in-flight = still live at closure (debt)

lane_rounds.description: lane id -> the lane's own round number the status refers to; makes not-dispatched rows falsifiable and ok rows derivable to a report path

trends.description: one evidence-backed Learning Path verdict per trend on future closure entries

minted.description: lane ids minted (or ratified) by this entry; empty on ordinary rounds

supersedes.description: identifies the prior ledger entry whose rows this correction replaces; present only on closure-correction entries

entry.description: zero-based array index disambiguating otherwise identical prior entries

protocol_updates.description: protocol-document changes ratified by this entry

notes.description: free-text evidence digest; cite paths and line numbers

lanes.comment: holds when at least one lane status is not-dispatched: the inner schema passes iff every status differs from not-dispatched

trendVerdict.description: one non-scalar Learning Path trend verdict
